# Aseda Praise (cornel.media/aseda-praise)

> Ghana's Premier Annual Gospel Concert & Community Healthcare Outreach Event in Tarkwa, Western Region.

## Event Overview
Aseda Praise is an annual flagship gospel music concert and corporate social responsibility (CSR) community healthcare outreach event held in Tarkwa, Ghana. Marking its 5th Anniversary Edition, the program features high-impact praise and worship ministrations alongside a free comprehensive health screening for elderly citizens at Apinto Government Hospital.

## Key Features & Highlights
- **100% Free Admission**: Open to all worshippers, community members, and families.
- **Anointed Minstrels**: Ministration by Brian Kuffour (Ghana Praise Medley), Joe Mettle, Seth Acheampong, and regional gospel choirs.
- **Community Healthcare Outreach**: Free blood pressure, diabetes, eye screening, and medication distribution for senior citizens.
- **Production Partners**: Media coverage, multi-cam live streaming, and website engineering by Cornel Media Productions and ElysTv.

## Contact Information
